context_length: Trained on crops of up to 1,024 residues; longer sequences are embedded whole here
summary: The 3B-parameter ESM-2 variant; larger capacity than the 650M model, with 2560-dim embeddings that often improve structure- and function-related tasks at higher compute cost.
architecture: Encoder-only BERT-style transformer (36 layers, 2560 hidden) with rotary position embeddings. Per-residue final hidden states are pooled by this benchmark.
pretraining_data: UniRef50 (2021_04 release), with each training sequence sampled from a cluster's UniRef90 members.
key_innovations: Scaling ESM-2 to 3B improves contact/structure recovery over 650M
Language-model backbone of ESMFold; same MLM recipe as the family, with 2560-dim embeddings
when_to_use: When extra representational capacity helps and the ~4× cost over the 650M model is acceptable; a strong upper-mid baseline in the ESM-2 line.
caveats: Substantially heavier than 650M for often-marginal gains on easy tasks; single-sequence only.

citations.title: Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model
